summary: Elevated 5xx series errors traced to backend proxy degradation causing runtime failovers
description:
Issue summary: Starting 2026-03-10 02:12 UTC we observed an elevated rate of 5xx responses from the hosted endpoint used by ParcelAI. Symptoms appeared as 502/503/504 spikes from the API gateway and an increased cadence of serving-runtime process restarts tied to failover logic. Impact affected a single dedicated tenant (ParcelAI) running on Dedicated capacity in us-east-1.

Initial hypothesis: A combination of degraded proxy performance (increased socket churn and TLS renegotiation fallbacks) plus aggressive autoscaler cooldowns caused upstream runtimes to experience connection pressure and trigger failover/restart orchestrations, amplifying 5xx rates.
impact: Customer-visible errors: sustained 5xx rate ~12% of requests to prediction endpoint over a 45-minute window, increased p95 latency from 120ms to 1.8s, streaming sessions dropped mid-response for ~18% of long-polling requests. ParcelAI reported production traffic errors and some user-facing timeouts affecting order processing features.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Send sustained concurrent streaming requests (~200 concurrent sessions) to tenant ParcelAI's /v1/chat/stream endpoint in us-east-1.
2) Observe gateway returning elevated 502/503s after roughly 5-10 minutes as connection churn increases.
3) Check serving-runtime logs for repeated 'upstream connection closed' and 'failover triggered' messages correlating with gateway 5xx timestamps.
logs_and_traces: API Gateway metrics: 2026-03-10 02:15-03:00 UTC -> 5xx spike from baseline 0.4% to 12.3% (mauve-prod-apigw-us-east).
Proxy logs: repeated TLS handshake fallback to lower cipher family and SYN retries on connection pool (proxy-03-us-east). See /var/log/proxy/proxy-03-2026-03-10.log lines 3421-3450.
Serving runtime: repeated 'evicting-kv-cache' entries prior to restart and 'failover: takeover by replica' at 02:27:14 UTC (runtime-tenant-378).
Tracing: distributed trace id trace-0b3f2a shows connection reset at apigw -> proxy boundary and subsequent request retries that hit downstream capacity limits.
investigation_notes: 02:30 UTC - Support (Maya) confirmed customer impact and escalated to SRE (Diego).

02:38 UTC - Correlated gateway 5xx increase with a simultaneous rise in proxy TCP retransmits and TLS renegotiation fallback events on proxy hosts. Packet drops and increased RTOs observed on instance proxy-03.

02:50 UTC - Observed autoscaler activity: several serving-runtime replicas were terminated as part of a scale-down that coincided with the spike, suggesting autoscaler cooldowns and scale-down thresholds contributed to capacity insufficiency during connection churn.
03:05 UTC - Reproduced partial failure in staging by artificially inducing connection churn on proxy to validate hypothesis (test run id repro-2026-03-10-proxy-churn).
timeline: 02:12 UTC - First alerts from SRE dashboards (5xx rate).
02:20 UTC - Pager and Slack alert to #support and #sre-incidents.
02:38 UTC - Initial mitigation: reduced connection keepalive timeout on apigw to 30s to relieve stale sockets.
02:55 UTC - Emergency autoscaler override: increased min replicas for ParcelAI serving pool by +2 to provide breathing room.
03:12 UTC - Temporary proxy config adjustment rolled out to disable aggressive TLS renegotiation fallback on proxy-02/03/04.
03:40 UTC - 5xx rate gradually declined to <1.5% as runtime restarts decreased and connection queue lengths stabilized.
comments: Maya Chen (Support) 2026-03-10 02:22 UTC: Customer reported spike in production errors. Collecting request IDs and duration metrics.
Diego Alvarez (SRE) 2026-03-10 02:36 UTC: Seeing proxy retransmit and TLS fallback rates spike. Hypothesis: proxy is dropping sessions which leads to upstream retries and runtime failovers.
ParcelAI (Customer) 2026-03-10 02:47 UTC: Confirmed reduction in user errors after you pushed the change. Thank you, still seeing occasional drops but much improved.
Diego Alvarez (SRE) 2026-03-10 04:10 UTC: Applied follow-up fix to autoscaler policy and created INT follow-up for deeper root-cause analysis: INT-2299.
Maya Chen (Support) 2026-03-11 09:15 UTC: Scheduled a post-incident call with ParcelAI for 2026-03-12 to review SLA credits and mitigation timeline.
resolution:
Mitigation applied: temporarily increased ParcelAI serving pool min replicas, tuned autoscaler cooldown to avoid scale-down during high connection churn, and disabled aggressive TLS fallback on proxy hosts. Result: 5xx rate returned to baseline (<1%) by 03:40 UTC.

Permanent follow-ups: INT-2299 (deep dive into proxy socket backlog and TLS negotiation behavior), PR #943 to add autoscaler hysteresis for dedicated tenants with streaming-heavy workloads, and a runbook update (linked above) that documents emergency knobs. Customer offered SLA credit; CS to confirm.
next_steps: Create INT-2299 for root cause RCA and capacity test plan (assigned to Diego).
Hardening: implement autoscaler hysteresis and streaming-aware scale-up policy (PR #943 referenced).
Observability: add specific alert for proxy TLS-fallback rate and connection queue depth to detect early degradation.
Schedule post-incident review with ParcelAI and internal stakeholders (2026-03-12).
